text:
marta: starting vega-15b (int4) canary on staging. streaming + defaults -> reproducible OOMs on coldstart when max_new_tokens=1024.

chris: paste the allocator errors pls

marta: logs:
E runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
E runtime: failed to allocate KV slab (requested 256MB)
W kv: slot_growth > 1.6x after first gen

ine: pattern we've seen before. streaming holds KV and large max_new_tokens forces a big reserve. quick mitigations: microbatch=1, default max_new_tokens=256 for canary, lower slot_reserve_ratio.

sam: pushed canary override:
microbatch: 1
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 256
kv:
  slot_reserve_ratio: 0.25
  soft_evict_threshold: 0.65

marta: applied via rollout. deploy bot: 3/3 healthy.

dev-bot: deploy: vega-15b-canary config applied by sam — rollout complete

marta: we still hit 1 OOM during a multi-turn with function-calling (prefix ~1500 tokens). reproducer: streaming + long prefix + user max 512 = fail.

chris: propose prefix gating: if prompt_tokens > 1200 -> route to non-streaming path or return helpful error. avoids unbounded KV growth.

ine: alternative: adaptive max_new = min(user_max, 1024 - prefix_tokens) for canary. simpler: conservative defaults + gating.

sam: queued small allocator soft-defrag after first gen (frees tiny slabs) in infra repo: https://git.internal/r/infra/vega-kv-defrag

marta: reran canary with config + defrag: 50 runs, 0 OOMs, mean latency +2%, 98p latency ~1.02x. harness: streaming multi-turns, avg prefix 900 tokens, qps 2.

chris: update onboarding playbook: canary defaults max_new_tokens=256, microbatch=1 for streaming models >=13b, enable coldstart soft-defrag, add prefix gating rule.

marta: opening PR to onboarding docs with config snippet and KV heuristics, linking logs and perf dashboard.

sam: add alert: KV slot_growth > 1.4 within first 5 gens -> page SRE + auto-rollback. :bell:

marta: added alert TODO in PR.

chris: after PR merge we can start slow prod rollout.

marta: closing thread 14 canary healthy after fixes, will add checklist entry. :tada:
